# WALSH IP LAW

> > Intellectual property and internet law practice serving Colorado, specializing in trademark, copyright, patent licensing, and digital privacy counsel.

WALSH IP LAW is Tom Walsh's intellectual property law practice based in the Denver/Englewood area, serving clients throughout Colorado. The firm provides comprehensive IP legal services including trademark and copyright protection, patent licensing, internet law, social media counsel, and dispute resolution.

## Core Services

- [Trademark, Copyright & Patent Licensing](https://www.walshiplaw.com/legal-services/intellectual-property): Comprehensive intellectual property services including trademark protection, copyright registration, patent licensing, and IP portfolio management
- [Internet & Social Media Counsel](https://www.walshiplaw.com/legal-services/privacy): Legal services for internet and social media matters, including domain name disputes, cybersquatting issues, and digital privacy counsel in Denver/Englewood, Colorado
